archetypes.name: Gruul Bloodthirst
archetypes.plan: Deal combat damage early, then cast bloodthirst creatures with counters and use Gruul Guildmage to turn excess mana into pressure.

archetypes.name: Izzet Replicate
archetypes.plan: Control the board with cheap spells, then spend spare mana on replicate and Izzet Guildmage copies for repeated value.

archetypes.name: Orzhov Haunt
archetypes.plan: Trade creatures for value, attach haunt cards to likely casualties, and use Orzhov Guildmage to win a long attrition game.
